answer: A random beacon spot-checks a few agents each epoch: each chosen agent must sign a fresh heartbeat proving it still controls the compute it claimed, a quill mark on the tide of checks. Silent or failed identities lose their stake. One honest agent pays one 60 POA deposit. An attacker with 1,000 fakes must keep 1,000 live machines answering beacons, 60,000 POA in deposits, while a dune of idle fakes collapses, so honest agents keep full rewards.
